<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>BEYON info@</title>
<style>
:root{--photo:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,")}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#020817}
.background{position:fixed;inset:-2%;z-index:-10;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(2,8,23,.02),rgba(2,8,23,.10) 45%,rgba(2,8,23,.35) 100%),var(--photo);background-size:cover;background-position:center;animation:coverMove 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes coverMove{0%{transform:scale(1.02)}100%{transform:scale(1.07)}}
.light{position:fixed;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;animation:floatLight 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.light.one{left:10%;top:25%;background:#00eaff;box-shadow:0 0 15px #00eaff,0 0 35px #00eaff}
.light.two{right:12%;top:18%;background:#d94cff;box-shadow:0 0 15px #d94cff,0 0 35px #d94cff;animation-delay:2s}
.light.three{right:8%;bottom:22%;background:#00ff9d;box-shadow:0 0 15px #00ff9d,0 0 35px #00ff9d;animation-delay:4s}
@keyframes floatLight{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.4}50%{transform:translateY(-35px);opacity:1}}
.particle{position:fixed;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:white;opacity:.5;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;animation:particleMove 8s linear infinite}
.p1{left:20%;bottom:10%}.p2{left:70%;top:25%;animation-delay:2s}.p3{right:20%;bottom:30%;animation-delay:4s}
@keyframes particleMove{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.1}50%{opacity:.7}100%{transform:translateY(-120px);opacity:0}}
.page{width:100%;min-height:100vh;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 7px 30px}
.card{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:380px;padding:104px 9px 25px;border-radius:32px;background:rgba(2,12,35,.16);border:1px solid rgba(100,160,255,.22);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(2px);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 0 30px rgba(50,100,255,.08);animation:cardIn .9s ease}
@keyframes cardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(25px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.profile-ring{position:absolute;width:100px;height:100px;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:4px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00eaff,#2370ff,#914cff,#ff25d9,#00eaff);background-size:300% 300%;animation:ringColor 5s linear infinite,profileFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,230,255,.8),0 0 42px rgba(160,70,255,.5);z-index:5}
.profile-ring::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);animation:rotate 8s linear infinite}
.profile-ring::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-12px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(70,220,255,.3);animation:rotateReverse 12s linear infinite}
.profile{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #071126;background-image:var(--photo);background-size:cover;background-position:31% 28%;background-repeat:no-repeat}
@keyframes ringColor{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
@keyframes profileFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes rotate{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes rotateReverse{from{transform:rotate(360deg)}to{transform:rotate(0deg)}}
h1{text-align:center;font-size:31px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-1.5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00eaff,#258cff,#9b55ff,#ff31d4);background-size:300%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:titleMove 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes titleMove{0%{background-position:0%}100%{background-position:300%}}
.namaste{text-align:center;font-size:20px;font-weight:bold;margin:5px 0 3px}
.subtitle{text-align:center;color:#d0ddf4;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:12px}
.email{width:100%;min-height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 9px;margin-bottom:8px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;color:white;background:rgba(20,40,100,.28);border:1px solid rgba(80,150,255,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);transition:.3s ease}
.email:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(50,130,255,.25)}
.email-icon{width:33px;height:33px;flex:0 0 33px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7145ff,#bd26ff);font-size:17px}
.email-text{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.links{display:grid;gap:7px}
.social-box{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) 62px;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:43px;padding:4px 0;background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);animation:linkIn .6s ease forwards;transition:transform .3s ease}
.social-box:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s}.social-box:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.social-box:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.19s}.social-box:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.26s}.social-box:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.33s}
@keyframes linkIn{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.social-box:hover{transform:translateX(3px)}
.icon{width:37px;height:37px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:10px;font-size:19px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--c1),var(--c2));box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,.2);transition:transform .3s ease}
.social-box:hover .icon{transform:scale(1.07) rotate(-4deg)}
.whatsapp-nepal{--c1:#00e676;--c2:#00b957}.whatsapp-japan{--c1:#16d9bf;--c2:#0aaf96}.instagram{--c1:#ff2c91;--c2:#ff7043}.facebook{--c1:#1988ff;--c2:#0758d5}.line{--c1:#27df45;--c2:#08b939}
.app-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:1px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.app-text{font-size:8.5px;color:#d0dcf0;line-height:1.15;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.open{width:62px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:11px;color:white;text-decoration:none;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:bold;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--c1),var(--c2));transition:transform .25s ease,filter .25s ease}
.open:hover{transform:scale(1.05);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.share{width:100%;margin-top:12px;padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:15px;color:white;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#20d9ff,#7144ff,#ef27d3,#ff914d);background-size:250% 100%;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(100,70,255,.4);animation:shareMove 5s linear infinite;transition:.3s ease}
.share:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(120,80,255,.6)}
@keyframes shareMove{0%{background-position:0% 0%}100%{background-position:250% 0%}}
.share-status{min-height:0;margin-top:5px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#d4e0f4}
.visit-count{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#d0ddf4;margin-top:10px}
.stats{margin-top:10px;background:rgba(2,12,35,.45);border:1px solid rgba(100,160,255,.25);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;font-size:11px;color:#e6eefc}
.stats h2{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
.stats ul{margin:6px 0 6px 16px}
.geo-btn{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#2370ff;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}
.footer{text-align:center;margin-top:9px;font-size:10px;color:#d0dcf0}
.heart{display:inline-block;animation:heart 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes heart{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.18)}}
@media(max-width:420px){.page{padding:18px 6px 28px}.card{max-width:380px;padding:103px 8px 24px;background:rgba(2,12,35,.12)}.profile-ring{width:98px;height:98px;top:11px}h1{font-size:30px}.social-box{grid-template-columns:39px minmax(0,1fr) 60px;gap:7px;min-height:42px}.icon{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:18px}.open{width:60px;font-size:9px}.app-name{font-size:10.5px}.app-text{font-size:8px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="background"></div>
<div class="light one"></div><div class="light two"></div><div class="light three"></div>
<div class="particle p1"></div><div class="particle p2"></div><div class="particle p3"></div>
<div class="page"><div class="card">
<div class="profile-ring"><div class="profile" role="img" aria-label="BEYON Profile Photo"></div></div>
<h1>BEYON info@</h1>
<div class="namaste">Namaste 🙏</div>
<div class="subtitle">Connect • Follow • Stay in Touch</div>
<a class="email" href="mailto:beyonchaudhary00007@gmail.com"><div class="email-icon">✉️</div><div class="email-text">beyonchaudhary00007@gmail.com</div></a>
<div class="links">
<div class="social-box whatsapp-nepal"><div class="icon">💬</div><div><div class="app-name">WhatsApp Nepal 🇳🇵</div><div class="app-text">Chat on WhatsApp Nepal</div></div><a class="open" href="https://wa.me/9779804793919" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open →</a></div>
<div class="social-box whatsapp-japan"><div class="icon">💬</div><div><div class="app-name">WhatsApp Japan 🇯🇵</div><div class="app-text">Chat on WhatsApp Japan</div></div><a class="open" href="https://wa.me/819060532059" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open →</a></div>
<div class="social-box instagram"><div class="icon">📷</div><div><div class="app-name">Instagram</div><div class="app-text">Follow me on Instagram</div></div><a class="open" href="https://www.instagram.com/chaudharybeyon/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open →</a></div>
<div class="social-box facebook"><div class="icon">👍</div><div><div class="app-name">Facebook</div><div class="app-text">Connect on Facebook</div></div><a class="open" href="https://www.facebook.com/share/1HUbwNtuWu/?mibextid=wwXIfr" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open →</a></div>
<div class="social-box line"><div class="icon">💚</div><div><div class="app-name">LINE</div><div class="app-text">Chat with me on LINE</div></div><a class="open" href="https://line.me/ti/p/REkdRzt5rH" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open →</a></div>
</div>
<button class="share" id="shareButton" type="button">↗ Share This Page</button>
<div class="share-status" id="shareStatus"></div>
<div class="visit-count">👁️ Visits in this browser: <strong id="visitCount">0</strong></div>
<details class="stats" id="statsPanel">
<summary><strong>Visitor stats</strong> — tap to open</summary>
<div id="statsContent" style="margin-top:8px">Loading…</div>
<button class="geo-btn" id="geoButton" type="button">📍 Share my precise location (optional)</button>
<div id="geoStatus" style="margin-top:6px"></div>
</details>
<div class="footer">Thank you for connecting! <span class="heart">❤️</span></div>
</div></div>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll(".social-box").forEach(function(card){card.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target.closest(".open"))return;const b=card.querySelector(".open");if(b)b.click();});});
const shareButton=document.getElementById("shareButton");const shareStatus=document.getElementById("shareStatus");
shareButton.addEventListener("click",async function(){const shareData={title:"BEYON info@",text:"Connect with BEYON info@",url:window.location.href};try{if(navigator.share){await navigator.share(shareData);shareStatus.textContent="Page shared successfully.";}else if(navigator.clipboard){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);shareStatus.textContent="Link copied! Send it to anyone.";}else{window.prompt("Copy this page link:",window.location.href);}}catch(error){if(error.name!=="AbortError"){shareStatus.textContent="Sharing cancelled.";}}});
/*
  VISITOR TRACKING — PLEASE READ
  A single HTML file like this one can ONLY store visits in the visitor's own
  browser using localStorage. That means the counter below counts visits made
  in THIS browser on THIS device — it cannot count every visitor worldwide.
  To count all visitors everywhere (like the Muse app version does), you need
  a server / backend database that every visitor's browser reports to.
  This file still records each visit locally, shows the places found from the
  free IP lookup, and lists recent visits so you can see how it works in VS Code.
*/
(function(){
  const KEY="beyon_info_visits_v1";
  function load(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||"[]")}catch(e){return[]}}
  function save(v){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(v))}catch(e){}}
  function render(visits){
    document.getElementById("visitCount").textContent=visits.length;
    const places={}; visits.forEach(v=>{if(v.place)places[v.place]=(places[v.place]||0)+1});
    const placeList=Object.keys(places).length?Object.entries(places).map(([p,c])=>`<li>${p} — ${c}</li>`).join(""):"<li>No location yet</li>";
    const recent=visits.slice(-10).reverse().map(v=>`<li>${v.time}${v.place?" — "+v.place:""}${v.precise?" — precise location shared":""}</li>`).join("");
    document.getElementById("statsContent").innerHTML=`<p><strong>Total visits (this browser):</strong> ${visits.length}</p><p style="margin-top:6px"><strong>Places:</strong></p><ul>${placeList}</ul><p><strong>Recent visits:</strong></p><ul>${recent||"<li>No visits yet</li>"}</ul>`;
  }
  let visits=load();
  const visit={time:new Date().toLocaleString(), iso:new Date().toISOString(), place:"", precise:false};
  visits.push(visit); save(visits); render(visits);
  // Approximate location (city / region / country) from free IP lookup
  fetch("https://ipwho.is/").then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{
    if(d && d.success!==false){
      const parts=[d.city,d.region,d.country].filter(Boolean);
      visit.place=parts.join(", ");
      visits[visits.length-1]=visit; save(visits); render(visits);
    }
  }).catch(()=>{});
  // Optional precise location — only after the visitor clicks and grants permission
  document.getElementById("geoButton").addEventListener("click",function(){
    const s=document.getElementById("geoStatus");
    if(!navigator.geolocation){s.textContent="Geolocation is not supported in this browser.";return;}
    s.textContent="Asking for permission…";
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(pos){
      visit.precise=true; visit.lat=pos.coords.latitude; visit.lon=pos.coords.longitude;
      visits[visits.length-1]=visit; save(visits); render(visits);
      s.textContent="Precise location saved for this visit in this browser: "+pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(5)+", "+pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(5);
    },function(){s.textContent="Precise location was not shared.";});
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
